description: FIDENTIS develops and applies multi-material laser powder bed fusion technology to automate the production of high-quality dental prosthetics.
funding_summary: Received €1.62 million in funding through the EXIST Transfer of Research program, co-financed by the European Union and the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action (BMWK) in July 2024.
inflection_why_now: The recent €1.62 million funding from the EXIST Transfer of Research program enables FIDENTIS to advance its technology and product development, positioning the company for significant growth in the dental prosthetics market.
devils_advocate_risks: Technological Validation: Ensuring the reliability and scalability of the multi-material laser powder bed fusion technology in mass production.
Market Adoption: Achieving widespread acceptance of the new dental prosthetics among dental professionals and patients.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in advanced materials and additive manufacturing, aligning with FIDENTIS's focus on multi-material laser powder bed fusion technology for dental prosthetics.
Bosch's expertise in precision engineering and manufacturing processes complements FIDENTIS's innovative approach to scalable dental prosthesis production.
